proxy_help: Only configured applications use the proxy. HTTP uses SOCKS port + 1.
tunnel_help: TUN routes IPv4 and IPv6. This development build has not passed device leak or recovery tests.
empty: No profiles yet. Import your own server configuration.
rules_help: Each rule: domains, ips (CIDR), action: proxy/direct/block. Split routing happens inside the core; applications remain captured by TUN.
advanced_help: Only a single supported outbound is accepted. File access, custom listeners and unsafe TLS options are rejected.
backup_help: Device/account-bound encrypted backup. Not portable to another device.
privacy: No accounts. No telemetry. Profiles stay on this device. Subscriptions contact their provider; connection checks contact Cloudflare through your proxy.
development: Development build · not a verified public release
listening: Local core running; reachability checked separately
invalid_profile: Invalid profile. Check the supported link format.
unsupported_feature: Unsupported protocol, transport or parameter. No silent substitution was made.
invalid_settings: Invalid mode, port, MTU or rule count.
loopback_only: Only loopback bind addresses are allowed.
invalid_dns: DNS must contain valid IPv4 / IPv6 addresses.
unsupported_platform: Tunnel mode is unavailable on this platform.
core_config_invalid: Xray rejected the configuration. Credentials were not logged.
core_start_failed: Could not start Xray. Check port conflicts, elevation and Wintun availability.
probe_failed: HTTPS through the proxy failed. The connection was closed. Check server access.
invalid_url: Use a valid HTTPS subscription URL without embedded login.
subscription_failed: Subscription download failed. Existing profiles were kept.
cleanup_failed: Cleanup failed. Check your system network settings.
storage_failed: Secure storage failed. No plaintext fallback is used.
operation_failed: Operation failed. No sensitive details were logged.
socket_protect_failed: Unable to protect the outbound socket.
name: Profile name
admin: Tunnel mode requires administrator rights and wintun.dll. Start RADVPN as administrator.
